subject: apps/api/src/content/VersionController.ts
note: The ledger row's subject is ContentVersionManager.ts, whose createVersion delegates to VersionController.createVersion; the tags are read in VersionController.createSnapshot. The snapshot drops the given tags. The first mutation, the snapshot dropping its array guard on the tags, read VACUOUS; this alternative reads VACUOUS too: the block reads only that createVersion resolves ok, and no reader sees the snapshot's tags, because storeVersion ignores its snapshot argument and the returned version carries none.
